planted_discrepancies.how_planted: OM 'annual rental income' includes vacant units at the landlord's asking rent (rent-roll potential), presented as income.
OM yield (ROI) is rent divided by asking price, before DLD 4%, agency 2% + VAT and registration fees.
Many tenancies were signed at 2025 peak rents; after the 2026 fall a large share of income sits above the area reference rent.

OM claims a double-digit income uplift within 12 months by comparing passing rents with asking rents for new lettings; passing rents already sit near the screen reference, so renewals allow 0% under Decree 43 and even uncapped re-lets at the reference add only a few percent.

expected.note: Supportable = every occupied unit re-let at the screen reference with no RERA cap (re-lets on turnover are uncapped); RERA renewal allowed = Decree 43 bands at renewal (top band 20%).
